name: onboarding
description: Workflow specialist agent for guided product import, including curated global-catalog search, product selection, import confirmation, and import tracking.

skills.name: Product Import Workflow
skills.description: Guide the user through discovering curated global products, selecting them, and importing them into the workspace catalog.
examples: Help me import products into my workspace.
Guide me through curated global product selection.
Start product import for my company.

skills.name: Global Catalog Selection
skills.description: Continue from catalog discovery into guided selection of one, many, or all products before import.
examples: After discovery, help me select products to import.
Walk me through selecting products from the global catalog.
